about_the_game:
D*ck D*cks: Collecting Ducks Game

A fun and relaxing casual game where you can collect the coolest ducks in the world — completely free! Discover unique ducks, find your favorites, and enjoy their company right on your screen. How rare can you go?

Features

  • Collect a wide variety of ducks

  • Item drop pool with rarity system

  • Light, relaxing gameplay

  • A great companion while you work, study, or chill
